name: Vanilla Emerald – General
description: STUB. Maps abstract terrain to vanilla Emerald metatiles. Every entry is TODO: fill in or verify each one in Porymap's tileset editor. Not used by the app until Milestone 7.

elevation.note: From include/global.fieldmap.h: ELEVATION_TRANSITION 0 (stairs), ELEVATION_SURF 1 (water), ELEVATION_DEFAULT 3 (ground), ELEVATION_MULTI_LEVEL 15 (bridges). Porymap's manual uses 4 for raised ground above 3 (Route 114 cliffs); each higher plateau is one more.
